title: The singleton dual Koszul coefficient cone with normalized unit and projections
statement: Let (C,J,O) be a small ringed site with commutative ring sheaf O and let a be a global section. Let Q_n be the strict internal-dual singleton Koszul tower, let I=O[0], and let f_n be single(a^(n+1)) on I [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. There are chain isomorphisms e_n: Q_n ≅ cone(f_n) which carry the specified dual unit I→Q_n to the cone inclusion. The graded maps given by e_n followed by the second cone projection commute with every successor transition, in every integer degree. No tensor by an arbitrary complex is present in this coefficient statement. No flatness, regularity, nonzero scalar, coefficient field or nonempty-site hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0A0E, lemma-derived-completion-koszul, finite free dual identification.

proof.text: Specialize ringedNegativeKoszulSuccDuality to rank one and retain its empty-subset unit identity. Compose the inverse duality isomorphism with the right unitor on the negative factor and the proved two-term doubleConeIso. The right-unitor inverse formula and unitors_inv_equal identify the empty-subset basis with the degree-zero double basis, which doubleConeHom sends to the cone inclusion. Single-source extensionality proves the coefficient unit identity.

The coefficient cone inclusion is an isomorphism in degree zero, with inverse its second projection, because the degree-one term of I is zero. Thus the normalized dual unit is invertible in degree zero. Dualizing ringedKoszulProjection_naturality gives naturality of the dual units for every successor. Cancel the degree-zero unit and use the normalized inclusion equation to obtain compatibility of the second projections in degree zero. Every other degree has zero target I^j, proving the remaining equations.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedSingletonCoefficientCone
    (a : (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) :
    ∃ e : ∀ n : ℕ,
        (ringedKoszulDualTower O 1 (fun _ ↦ a)).obj (op n) ≅
          CochainComplex.mappingCone
            ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).map
              (ringedKoszulScalar O a ^ (n + 1))),
      (∀ n, ringedKoszulDualUnit O 1 (fun _ ↦ a) n ≫ (e n).hom =
        CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr
          ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).map
            (ringedKoszulScalar O a ^ (n + 1)))) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (j : ℤ),
        ((ringedKoszulDualTower O 1 (fun _ ↦ a)).map
            (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right n 1)).op).f j ≫
          (e n).hom.f j ≫
            (CochainComplex.mappingCone.snd
              ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).map
                (ringedKoszulScalar O a ^ (n + 1)))).v j j (add_zero j) =
          (e (n + 1)).hom.f j ≫
            (CochainComplex.mappingCone.snd
              ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).map
                (ringedKoszulScalar O a ^ (n + 1 + 1)))).v j j (add_zero j))
